title: This week at the pass
intro: Three plates the kitchen is cooking right now. They change when the market changes, usually on a Tuesday.

items.name: Scallop, cauliflower, caviar
items.note: Hand-dived scallop, browned butter cauliflower, oscietra
items.alt: Roasted scallops with cauliflower puree and caviar on a slate plate

items.name: Lamb shoulder, onion, pedro ximénez
items.note: Nine hours in the oven, charred onion petals, sherry reduction
items.alt: Slow braised lamb shoulder with charred onion petals and a dark reduction

items.name: Chocolate, olive oil, salt
items.note: Seventy percent ganache tart, Alentejo oil, crème fraîche
items.alt: Dark chocolate and olive oil tart with gold leaf and a creme fraiche quenelle
